bodyHtml:
§288-1  Application of chapter.  This chapter shall not be applicable to any common carrier subject to section 269-21. [L 1943, c 171, §2; RL 1945, §7430; RL 1955, §160-140; HRS §288-1]

 

Note

 

  Section 269-21 referred to in text is repealed.
